Not in the game yet

This page answers the common “is this in the game?” questions. Each item is checked against the game source for the audited version. Planned features are marked as planned, and no guide describes how they work until they ship.

Voxelgame main dd29d91 · 3 min read · Everyone · feature ledger · all guides

Fire

Planned, not in the game. There is no fire you can light, spread or put out. Explosions show a brief flash and burst and leave nothing burning. Fire

The FIRE & FOOD crafting tab holds recipes only: charcoal, cooked meat, glass and flasks are made instantly there, with no campfire or furnace to place. Charcoal, cooking and glass (no furnace)

Planned, not in the game. Campfires, furnaces and spreading fire are not in the game yet.

Lava

Planned, not in the game. There is no lava liquid. Volcanic areas and lava tubes are solid rock: basalt, obsidian, lava rock, pahoehoe and magma stone. Lava tubes are cooled and walkable. Nothing flows, burns or cools into stone. Lava
Good to know. Only water flows in this version, so there is no lava pool to avoid.

Waterfalls and dripstone

Planned, not in the game. There are no natural waterfalls, stalactites, stalagmites or dripstone caves. Water you place in creative mode can pour over an edge, but no cascade is drawn and the waterfall sound is not used. Natural waterfalls and dripstone caves

Chests and furniture

Planned, not in the game. Closets, chairs, beds, sofas, stools and extendable tables are requested but not in this version. Wooden chests and wooden doors are in the game now: see Wooden chests and Wooden doors in Building. Furniture

Player skins

Planned, not in the game. Your explorer wears one built-in outfit with fixed colours. There is no skin editor, and no skin import or export. Player skins and skin editor

Multiplayer

Good to know. Multiplayer is in development. The start menu has a Multiplayer page for joining a server, for joining worlds hosted on your network and for hosting your world. Hosting and the network list are described from source and not play-tested yet. Server admin tools are not done. Join a dedicated server (--connect) Multiplayer menu: list of worlds hosted on the LAN Multiplayer menu: Host this world (LAN hosting)
  1. Choose Multiplayer on the start menu.
  2. Type the server address in SERVER, as HOST or HOST:PORT. The port is 27015 unless you give one. Leave out spaces: the page refuses an address with a space inside it.
  3. Type the name others see in NAME, up to 32 bytes. Leave it empty to use your login name. Tab switches between the two fields.
  4. Press Enter, or choose Join server. To reuse one of the last 8 servers, click its row.

Joining saves your local world first. If you are already on a server, the game waits for your last block edits to reach it before leaving. The server's world is never saved to your computer. A failed join stays on the page with the reason. A server is added to the list only after it welcomes you and its world matches.

A join gives up after 15 seconds in all. The time includes looking up the server name. To stop a join while it is loading, press Esc on the loading screen. The page then says Stopped joining. If the server had already welcomed you, you leave it again.

On a server you see other players' arm swings. A player who punches, mines or places a block shows the swing on their character. The swing is only a picture: it does not change their reach or what they can build or break.

Worlds hosted on your network appear above your remembered servers while the Multiplayer page is open. The list shows up to 8 worlds, each with its name and address, and updates by itself. Only worlds on the same local network appear. Select a row and press Enter, or click it, to join. Your own hosted world is not listed. A world from another game version is shown as a world for another game version. If the selected world stops hosting, the selection moves to Join server.

To host your world for players on your network, use Host this world on the same page:

  1. Choose Host this world between Join and Back. The button reads Stop hosting while the world is hosted.
  2. Read the address on the page. Other players type it in SERVER. The port is 27015 when it is free; otherwise the page shows another port, so type the port too.
  3. Other players type their name in NAME and choose Join server.
  4. Choose Stop hosting when you are done. The world is saved, everyone is disconnected and your save loads for single play. Blocks you placed just before you stop are saved too.

If the save fails, for example because the disk is full, the status line says why. The world stays hosted and in play, so make room and try again. F6 and the 30-second autosave also report a failed save. If the save fails while you stop hosting, the world still stops and reopens from the copy on disk. The status line reads "Hosting stopped, but its last save failed".

  • Your computer must stay on and on the same network as the players.
  • To join a server, choose Stop hosting first.
  • Loading or creating another world, opening the Structure Workshop or quitting stops hosting first. The world is saved before it stops.
  • Hosting starts with your saved position, inventory, hotbar, tool, home, rest point and journal. Items you collect or use while hosting are saved with the world, and single play resumes from there. Resting while hosting moves your rest point, and it stays there after you stop hosting.

You can also start the game with --connect=HOST[:PORT] and --name=NAME, for example voxelgame --connect=HOST --name=NAME. You see other players, can build together and chat.

  • Use it on a LAN or the same computer only.
  • In survival, damage and death do not apply while you are connected.
  • Animals, inventories and crafting are not shared.
  • Water flow comes from the server.
  • The first server you join is trusted. If its certificate later changes, the game refuses to connect.

Build a server from source with the separate voxelgame-server program. The installers do not build it. voxelgame-server --world DIR hosts a world on 127.0.0.1:27015, and the server console accepts /list, /say, /save, /stop and /help. Run a dedicated server (voxelgame-server)

While connected, press Enter to open the chat line and Enter again to send it. Press Esc to cancel. Messages stay on screen for 10 seconds, and your keys do not move the player while you type. Multiplayer chat

When a feature ships

A feature moves off this page only after the game ships it and its source is checked. Its own guide then replaces the entry here.

How this guide was checked

Each item comes from the feature ledger, which cites the game source for the audited version. The absence checks searched the source for block, recipe and gameplay names. Fire, lava, waterfall, dripstone and fixed explorer colours were spot-checked again at game commit ddc0042.
